People: Ármin Vámbéry (author, Wikidata Q557360), died 1913. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Vámbéry, Ármin, 1832-1913") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.
